FORENSIC SCIENCE LABORATORY REPORT

Reference case: FIR No. 47/2026

Items received: swab/sample from damaged front portion of vehicle and control
material.

Laboratory observation: the submitted sample contained biological material suitable for
comparison testing.

The report records laboratory observations and does not independently establish the complete
circumstances of the incident.
